caption: This shoyu ramen features an amber-brown, glossy broth with floating noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with blue floral pattern, dark green nori, pinkish chashu pork, and pale yellow menma are served on a warm wooden table.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly crispy, browned surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft texture and faint green specks on their curved, elongated surface.
White ceramic bowl with blue floral pattern and slightly raised rim, smooth surface with faint residue inside.
